findings.finding: Each packet asks one family question over at most three focal turn pairs and permits at most two records.
All source sentences remain exact and aliased; protected targets and fixture answers are absent from every prompt.
Chronology and role-valid citation regions are deterministic. Relevance, relationship meaning, uncertainty, and semantic selection remain model judgments.
Prior context is generally non-citable. It may support only a challenge's prior frame or a position's starting state; all other roles remain focal.
Schemas are strict, auxiliary and mechanical parking fields are absent, query and relationship contract follow the source context, and record-level custody preserves valid siblings.
The design raises the ceiling from eleven to nineteen calls and from thirty to thirty-eight records per case. A one-call failure-target probe must demonstrate value before a full case is considered.
A three-pair shard can still contain more than two plausible records. The smallest probe directly tests whether the omitted Case-05 evidence boundary survives this remaining competition.

decision.reason: This is the smallest target-blind shard containing the evidence-family target omitted by the Phase-4 global reader, and evidence failed on both transfer cases.

nonclaims: Cold-reader pass is not model-behavior evidence.
Protected fixture compilation is same-session and non-independent.
One passing shard would not authorize nineteen calls or prove transfer.
